_meta.note: Rates provided by user who manually verified the in-app Offering Rates screen in the Pokémon TCG Pocket app. A4 screenshots stored in 'Offering Rates screenshots/' (gitignored). Pulsing Aura (B3) screenshots shared in ChatGPT conversation — NOT stored in this repository.

verifications.source_location: In-repo screenshots: 'Offering Rates screenshots/IMG_1692 2.PNG' through 'IMG_1722 2.PNG' (31 PNG files). Stored in 'Offering Rates screenshots/' (gitignored, not committed to repo).
verifications.verification_notes: Ho-Oh verified directly from screenshots. Lugia (A4) shares the same expansion and has identical branch probabilities and slot rates — inferred without direct screenshot. A4b (Deluxe Pack: ex) could not be verified: pack shows 'cannot be obtained right now' in app; Offering Rates screen inaccessible. A4b also uses 4 cards per pack (non-standard), not 5.

branch_selection.note: Three-branch model confirmed. Rates verified from IMG_1692 (Regular=91.620%), IMG_1709 (Regular+1=8.330%), IMG_1705 (Rare=0.050%).

regular_pack_plus_one.description: Pack opens with 6 cards; card 6 uses standard rarity (NOT shiny)

cards_1_to_3.note: 100% one_diamond for each of slots 1-3. Confirmed from IMG_1709 (slots 1-3 shown as ◇=100%).

card_4.note: Rates verified from IMG_1693–1698. High-rarity tiers (☆ and above) exact match to standard model. Sub-groups within ◇◇ and ◇◇◇ rows account for pool-specific fractions; all values sum to 100%.
card_4.sum_check: Standard rates used; pool sub-groups account for apparent discrepancies in ◇◇/◇◇◇ rows

card_5.note: Rates verified from IMG_1699–1704. Same sub-group behaviour as card_4.

rare_pack_slot_model.note: All 5 slots in a rare/god pack. Verified from IMG_1705–1708. Screenshots show uniform ~2.564% per card (~39 cards in pool = 1/39). Standard 40/50/5/5 tier placeholder retained in model pending explicit confirmation of this apparent uniform distribution.

cards_1_to_5_each.placeholder_note: Standard tier placeholder; in-app screenshots suggest uniform per-card distribution (~2.564%). Confirm explicitly before updating.

card_6.note: Card 6 uses STANDARD rarity (NOT shiny). Verified from IMG_1722 2.PNG.
